sections.heading: Visualizing a composite function and its derivative

questions.q: The graph shows $f(x)=(x-1)^2$ (an inner-outer composite of $u=x-1$ and $u^2$), with its tangent line at $x=2$.
parts: Use the chain rule to find $f'(x)$.
Confirm $f'(2)$ matches the slope of the tangent line shown.
answers: $f'(2)=2(1)=2$, matching the tangent line $y=2x-2$, which has slope $2$.
